messages.subject: legend in error-bar plot
parts:
Hello,

I'd like to create a error-bar plot (with the mean and the SD).
That is working really fine with:

ggplot(data.sum, aes(x=DOP, y=MD, shape=group.factor,group=group.factor)) +
scale_x_continuous("Days of pregnancy")+
scale_y_continuous("Mean diameter")+
geom_point(position=position_dodge(.2)) +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=MD-sd, ymax=MD+sd),
width=.1,position=position_dodge(.2),color="grey50")+
theme_bw()

But how can I create a legend which is showing me the symbols for the
group.factors? This legend should be inside the "box".

Is there any theme to set the box (axis) black and remove the grey grid lines?

Thank you,

best regards,
Johannes

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: legend in error-bar plot
parts:
For legend positioning and modification of grid lines, see the ggplot2
wiki and a nice page that illustrates how various opts() work:
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/%2Bopts%28%29-List

See legend.position() and panel.grid.major()/panel.grid.minor() under
legend() options and panel() options, respectively.

For some themes that have been submitted, see
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/themes/


Here's a reproducible example (hint) that might be helpful:

df <- data.frame(A = factor(rep(c('A1', 'A2'), each = 100)),
B = rep(1:5, each = 20), y = rnorm(200))
dfstats <- ddply(df, .(A, B), summarise, m = mean(y), s = sd(y))

ggplot(dfstats, aes(x = B, y = m, colour = A)) +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = m - s, ymax = m + s), size = 1,
position = position_dodge()) +
ylim(-1.5, 1.5) +
labs(x = 'B', y = 'y', colour = 'Group') +
opts(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.92),
panel.grid.major = theme_blank(),
panel.grid.minor = theme_blank())


Dennis
